mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repayment_schedule WHERE due_date < #{baseDate} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY schedule_id
mapper.update: UPDATE repayment_schedule SET status = 'OVERDUE' WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status, paid_at AS paidAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY sequence ASC

SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, GREATEST( total_payment_due - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(pr.amount) FROM payment_record pr WHERE pr.payment_target_type = 'LOAN' AND pr.target_id = repayment_schedule.schedule_id AND pr.record_status = 'CONFIRMED' ), 0), 0 ) AS remainingPaymentAmount, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status, paid_at AS paidAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE contract_id IN #{contractId}
ORDER BY sequence ASC

SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status, paid_at AS paidAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'OVERDUE') ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, contract_id AS contractId, sequence AS sequence, due_date AS dueDate, principal_due AS principalDue, interest_due AS interestDue, total_payment_due AS totalPaymentDue, remaining_principal AS remainingPrincipal, status AS status, paid_at AS paidAt FROM repayment_schedule WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT debtor_id FROM loan_contract WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
SELECT schedule_id FROM repayment_schedule WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND due_date <= #{cutoffDate}
